$comment: Cohort cache for Piggy. UNPOPULATED ON PURPOSE. Fill this by running queries/ against Dune with your own account and pasting the results here. Piggy reports cohorts as unavailable while this is empty — it must never show numbers that were not measured.
method: Wallets are grouped by funding signature (how money arrives), then outcomes are reported for every wallet in the group, not only the ones that did well.
